row.operative_statement: For BTRL with T>=1,proper closed lambda_t-strongly convex cumulative G_t,lambda_t>0,finite feasible played/comparator values and actual minimizers x_t, define ghost x_(T+1)=x_T. Prove R_T(u)<=psi_T(u)-psi1(x1)-sum_(t<T)lambda_t||x_t-x_(t+1)||^2/2+sum_(t<T)(psi_t(x_(t+1))-psi_(t+1)(x_(t+1))). Optional stronger endpoint is-lambda_T||u-x_T||^2/2. Original Algorithm15.9 defines no x_(T+1); repeating last loss gives checked0<=-1/36 and is not accepted.

printed_vs_repaired.printed: With source rounds 1,…,T and comparator u∈V, the printed upper bound is ψ_T(u)−ψ₁(x₁)−Σ_{t=1}^T (λ_t/2)‖x_t−x_{t+1}‖²+Σ_{t=1}^{T−1}(ψ_t(x_{t+1})−ψ_{t+1}(x_{t+1})). The algorithm only chooses x₁,…,x_T.
printed_vs_repaired.repair: Take T≥1 and positive supplied λ_t. Set the endpoint in the inclusive identity to x_T. Thus there are exactly T−1 actual movement terms. The stronger inequality also subtracts (λ_T/2)‖u−x_T‖². A separate theorem derives a unique feasible minimizer at each actual round.
printed_vs_repaired.rejected: Repeating the last loss instead of using the last real point invents a different update. For T=1, ψ(v)=v²/2, ℓ(v)=(v−1)²/2, x₁=u=1/2 and λ₁=2, that update is 2/3 and would give the false inequality 0≤−1/36.
printed_vs_repaired.zero_based: Source round t is Lean t−1. The last real index is T−1; it is not the natural-number extension x T of the supplied trajectory.

carriers.source: Regularizers live on X, real-round losses are ambient and take values in ℝ∪{+∞}, finite on V. The inclusive objective is real-valued on V; no convexity or closedness of every individual loss is assumed.
carriers.relative: Closed real sublevels on X restrict along the continuous inclusion V→X. Since V is closed in the ambient space, their feasible restrictions are ambient closed. Chords of V stay in V and hence in X.
carriers.ambient: Let F be an ambient representative agreeing with the inclusive objective on X. If F is proper, it excludes −∞ on X. Its finite witness need not belong to X. Instead choose a point of nonempty V ⊆ X: the regularizer is real and each loss through the current round is finite there, so the inclusive objective is finite there. For finite endpoints in X, ambient strong convexity applies on the effective domain of F and transfers to each interpolated point that lies in X. Closed real sublevels of F restrict to closed relative sublevels on X. If a closed F agrees only on V, closedness of V still makes the feasible real sublevels closed in the ambient space.
carriers.boundary: X itself need not be closed. Extending by +∞ off X may destroy closedness, as x² on (−1,1) shows. Positive curvature and the regret penalties use the original norm; coordinates are used only to obtain a supporting functional.

theorem btrl_real_round_minimizer_existsUnique {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (X V : Set E) (hVX : V ⊆ X)
    (hVconv : Convex ℝ V) (hVclosed : IsClosed V) (hVnonempty : V.Nonempty)
    (psi : ℕ → X → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal)
    (hlossBot : ∀ i < T, ∀ v, loss i v ≠ ⊥)
    (hlossDom : ∀ i < T, V ⊆ effectiveDomain (loss i))
    (lam : ℕ → ℝ) (hlam : ∀ t < T, 0 < lam t)
    (hproper : ∀ t < T, SourceProper (sourceInclusive X psi loss t))
    (hclosed : ∀ t < T, SourceClosed (sourceInclusive X psi loss t))
    (hstrong : ∀ t < T, ∀ p q : X,
      sourceInclusive X psi loss t p < ⊤ → sourceInclusive X psi loss t q < ⊤ →
      ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → a < 1 → ∀ hz : a • p.val + (1 - a) • q.val ∈ X,
        sourceInclusive X psi loss t ⟨a • p.val + (1 - a) • q.val, hz⟩ ≤
          (a : EReal) * sourceInclusive X psi loss t p +
          ((1 - a : ℝ) : EReal) * sourceInclusive X psi loss t q -
          (((lam t / 2) * a * (1 - a) * ‖p.val - q.val‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : EReal)) :
    ∀ t < T, ∃! p : E, p ∈ V ∧ IsMinOn (feasibleInclusive X V hVX psi loss t) V p

corrected_btrl_terminal_bound.declaratio.text_LF:
theorem corrected_btrl_terminal_bound {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (X V : Set E) (hVX : V ⊆ X)
    (hVconv : Convex ℝ V) (hVclosed : IsClosed V) (hVnonempty : V.Nonempty)
    (psi : ℕ → X → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal)
    (hlossBot : ∀ i < T, ∀ v, loss i v ≠ ⊥)
    (hlossDom : ∀ i < T, V ⊆ effectiveDomain (loss i))
    (lam : ℕ → ℝ) (hlam : ∀ t < T, 0 < lam t)
    (hproper : ∀ t < T, SourceProper (sourceInclusive X psi loss t))
    (hclosed : ∀ t < T, SourceClosed (sourceInclusive X psi loss t))
    (hstrong : ∀ t < T, ∀ p q : X,
      sourceInclusive X psi loss t p < ⊤ → sourceInclusive X psi loss t q < ⊤ →
      ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → a < 1 → ∀ hz : a • p.val + (1 - a) • q.val ∈ X,
        sourceInclusive X psi loss t ⟨a • p.val + (1 - a) • q.val, hz⟩ ≤
          (a : EReal) * sourceInclusive X psi loss t p +
          ((1 - a : ℝ) : EReal) * sourceInclusive X psi loss t q -
          (((lam t / 2) * a * (1 - a) * ‖p.val - q.val‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : EReal))
    (x : ℕ → E) (hx : ∀ t < T, x t ∈ V)
    (hmin : ∀ t < T, IsMinOn (feasibleInclusive X V hVX psi loss t) V (x t))
    (u : E) (hu : u ∈ V) :
    let r := regularizerValue X psi
    let regret := (∑ t ∈ range T, (loss t (x t)).toReal) -
      ∑ t ∈ range T, (loss t u).toReal
    let corrected := r (T - 1) u - r 0 (x 0) -
      (∑ t ∈ range (T - 1), (lam t / 2) * ‖x t - x (t + 1)‖ ^ 2) +
      ∑ t ∈ range (T - 1), (r t (x (t + 1)) - r (t + 1) (x (t + 1)))
    regret ≤ corrected - (lam (T - 1) / 2) * ‖u - x (T - 1)‖ ^ 2 ∧
      regret ≤ corrected

import BanditRLProof.OnlineCumulativePotential
import BanditRLProof.OnlineStrongConvexMinimum
import BanditRLProof.OnlineStrongConvexAttainment

noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
open Set Finset
open BanditRL.OnlineConvex
namespace BanditRL.OnlineBTRL

/-- A real extension for evaluating a source regularizer. All uses in the regret bound are in X. -/
def regularizerValue {E : Type*} (X : Set E) (psi : ℕ → X → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : E → ℝ :=
  Function.extend Subtype.val (psi n) (fun _ => 0)

/-- Source inclusive objective on its given carrier. -/
def sourceInclusive {E : Type*} (X : Set E) (psi : ℕ → X → ℝ)
    (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (n : ℕ) (w : X) : EReal :=
  (psi n w : EReal) + ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), loss i w.val

/-- Restriction to the feasible set, extended by top outside it. -/
def feasibleInclusive {E : Type*} (X V : Set E) (hVX : V ⊆ X)
    (psi : ℕ → X → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (n : ℕ) (v : E) : EReal :=
  if hv : v ∈ V then sourceInclusive X psi loss n ⟨v, hVX hv⟩ else ⊤

context.lean.txt.text_LF:
import Mathlib
noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
open Set Finset
namespace BanditRL.OnlineBTRLCanary

structure Model where
  T : ℕ
  X : Set ℝ
  V : Set ℝ
  psi : ℕ → X → ℝ
  loss : ℕ → ℝ → EReal
  lam : ℕ → ℝ
  x : ℕ → ℝ
  u : ℝ

def repeatedLast : Model :=
  ⟨1, univ, univ, fun _ w => w.val^2 / 2,
    fun _ v => (((v-1)^2 / 2 : ℝ) : EReal), fun _ => 2,
    fun t => if t = 0 then 1/2 else 17, 1/2⟩

def twoRounds : Model :=
  ⟨2, univ, Icc (-1) 3, fun t w => if t = 0 then w.val^2/2 else w.val^2,
    fun t v => if v ∈ Icc (-1:ℝ) 3 then
      ((if t = 0 then -v else -3*v : ℝ) : EReal) else ⊤,
    fun t => if t = 0 then 1 else 2,
    fun t => if t = 0 then 1 else if t = 1 then 2 else 100, 0⟩

def constrained : Model :=
  ⟨1, univ, Icc 0 1, fun _ w => w.val^2/2,
    fun _ v => ((-2*v : ℝ) : EReal), fun _ => 1,
    fun t => if t = 0 then 1 else 17, 0⟩

def openCarrier : Model :=
  ⟨1, Ioo (-1) 1, Icc (-1/2) (1/2), fun _ w => w.val^2,
    fun _ _ => 0, fun _ => 2, fun t => if t = 0 then 0 else 17, 1/2⟩

def r (m : Model) (t : ℕ) : ℝ → ℝ :=
  Function.extend Subtype.val (m.psi t) (fun _ => 0)

def g (m : Model) (t : ℕ) (v : m.X) : EReal :=
  (m.psi t v : EReal) + ∑ i ∈ range (t+1), m.loss i v.val

def h (m : Model) (t : ℕ) (v : ℝ) : EReal :=
  if hv : v ∈ m.V then
    if hx : v ∈ m.X then g m t ⟨v,hx⟩ else ⊤
  else ⊤

def regret (m : Model) : ℝ :=
  (∑ t ∈ range m.T, (m.loss t (m.x t)).toReal) -
    ∑ t ∈ range m.T, (m.loss t m.u).toReal

def baseline (m : Model) : ℝ := r m (m.T-1) m.u - r m 0 (m.x 0)
def movement (m : Model) : ℝ :=
  -(∑ t ∈ range (m.T-1), (m.lam t / 2) * ‖m.x t - m.x (t+1)‖ ^ 2)
def drift (m : Model) : ℝ :=
  ∑ t ∈ range (m.T-1), (r m t (m.x (t+1)) - r m (t+1) (m.x (t+1)))
def terminal (m : Model) : ℝ :=
  -(m.lam (m.T-1) / 2) * ‖m.u - m.x (m.T-1)‖ ^ 2
def weak (m : Model) : ℝ := baseline m + movement m + drift m
def sharp (m : Model) : ℝ := weak m + terminal m

def bounds (m : Model) : Prop := regret m ≤ sharp m ∧ regret m ≤ weak m
def attainment (m : Model) : Prop :=
  ∀ t < m.T, ∃! p : ℝ, p ∈ m.V ∧ IsMinOn (h m t) m.V p
def runValid (m : Model) : Prop :=
  m.V ⊆ m.X ∧ Convex ℝ m.V ∧ IsClosed m.V ∧ m.V.Nonempty ∧ m.u ∈ m.V ∧
    ∀ t < m.T, m.x t ∈ m.V ∧ IsMinOn (h m t) m.V (m.x t)
def closedLevels {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] (f : α → EReal) : Prop :=
  ∀ c : ℝ, IsClosed {v | f v ≤ (c : EReal)}
def wrongExtension (v : ℝ) : EReal :=
  if v ∈ openCarrier.X then ((v^2 : ℝ) : EReal) else ⊤

repeated_last_bound_and_fake_ghost.decla.text_LF:
theorem repeated_last_bound_and_fake_ghost :
    let m := repeatedLast
    bounds m ∧ attainment m ∧ runValid m ∧
    m.x 0 = 1/2 ∧ m.u = 1/2 ∧ m.x 1 = 17 ∧
    regret m = 0 ∧ weak m = 0 ∧ sharp m = 0 ∧
    (∀ p : ℝ, IsMinOn (h m 0) m.V p ↔ p = 1/2) ∧
    (∀ p : ℝ, IsMinOn (fun v => r m 0 v + 2 * (m.loss 0 v).toReal) m.V p ↔ p = 2/3) ∧
    weak m - (m.lam 0 / 2) * ‖m.x 0 - (2/3 : ℝ)‖ ^ 2 = -(1/36 : ℝ) ∧
    ¬ regret m ≤ weak m - (m.lam 0 / 2) * ‖m.x 0 - (2/3 : ℝ)‖ ^ 2

two_round_endpoint_and_drift.declaration.text_LF:
theorem two_round_endpoint_and_drift :
    let m := twoRounds
    bounds m ∧ attainment m ∧ runValid m ∧
    m.x 0 = 1 ∧ m.x 1 = 2 ∧ m.x 2 = 100 ∧ m.x 2 ≠ m.x (m.T-1) ∧
    m.loss 0 4 = ⊤ ∧ m.loss 1 4 = ⊤ ∧ regret m = -7 ∧ baseline m = -(1/2 : ℝ) ∧
    movement m = -(1/2 : ℝ) ∧ drift m = -2 ∧ terminal m = -4 ∧ sharp m = -7 ∧ weak m = -3

constrained_minimum_and_ambient_minimum..text_LF:
theorem constrained_minimum_and_ambient_minimum :
    let m := constrained
    bounds m ∧ attainment m ∧ runValid m ∧
    m.x 0 = 1 ∧ (2 : ℝ) ∉ m.V ∧
    (∀ p : ℝ, IsMinOn (fun v => r m 0 v + (m.loss 0 v).toReal) univ p ↔ p = 2) ∧
    (∀ p : ℝ, (p ∈ m.V ∧ IsMinOn (h m 0) m.V p) ↔ p = 1) ∧
    regret m = -2 ∧ weak m = -(1/2 : ℝ) ∧ terminal m = -(1/2 : ℝ) ∧ sharp m = -1

open_carrier_closed_transfer.declaration.text_LF:
theorem open_carrier_closed_transfer :
    let m := openCarrier
    bounds m ∧ attainment m ∧ runValid m ∧
    ¬ IsClosed m.X ∧ closedLevels (g m 0) ∧
    closedLevels (fun v : ℝ => ((v^2 : ℝ) : EReal)) ∧
    (∀ v : m.X, g m 0 v = ((v.val ^ 2 : ℝ) : EReal)) ∧
    closedLevels (h m 0) ∧ {v : ℝ | wrongExtension v ≤ 1} = m.X ∧
    ¬ closedLevels wrongExtension ∧ m.x 0 = 0 ∧
    regret m = 0 ∧ weak m = 1/4 ∧ sharp m = 0
